description.narrative: Providing core support to the objectives of the Strategic Plan 2022- 2025 of the Together for Life organization in Albania. The organization overall objective is to work towards achieving an equitable society, which does not discriminate against the poor, the weak, women or minorities; increase people’s rights and promote development, by working at the grassroots level with individual people and communities.

Tillhandahålla kärnstöd till målen i Strategiplanen 2022-2025 organisationen Together for Life i Albanien. Organisationens övergripande mål är att arbeta för att uppnå ett rättvist samhälle, som inte diskriminerar fattiga, svaga, kvinnor eller minoriteter; öka människors rättigheter och främja utveckling genom att arbeta på gräsrotsnivå med enskilda människor och samhällen.

The contribution will provide core Support to "Together for Life (TFL)" organization as per the Strategic Plan of the Organization 2026-2030.
The main strategic goals of TFLs Strategic Plan are: I. Strengthen Public Health Governance This strategic direction aims to enhance transparency and accountability in public health governance in Albania by promoting evidence based and participatory policymaking, as well as stronger intersectoral collaboration.
II. Empower Marginalized Groups for Inclusion and Equal Opportunity This strategic direction focuses on empowering marginalized groups including women, young women and men with disabilities and other marginalized communities to actively participate in civic life and decisionmaking processes.
III. Promote Green Development and Climate Resilience This strategic direction contributes to sustainable green development and climate resilience, including community preparedness for emergencies, in alignment with Albania s EU integration priorities.
IV. Enhance TFL Organizational Development and Sustainability This strategic direction focuses on building a resilient, efficient, and strategically positioned organization, enabling TFL to sustain its impact, strengthen its credibility and effectively deliver its mission.

description.narrative: During 2025, Together for Life further consolidated its role as a leading civil society actor in promoting transparency and accountability in the health sector. In overall the results of the organization's activity for 2025 has been the following: - Six monitoring and research reports were produced focusing on the assessment of public financial management in healthcare, the transparency and efficiency of public procurement practices, citizens perceptions and institutional responses to corruption,the prevalence of informal payments and the analysis of high level corruption cases in the healthcare sector. - In 2025, TFL further strengthened its institutional engagement with public authorities, including the Parliamentary Institute of Albania and the Minister of State for Public Administration and AntiCorruption. As a result of this collaboration, all monitoring reports produced by TFL on the health sector were officially included in the Parliamentary Library and made available to Members of Parliament. - At the organisational level, TFL continued to strengthen its internal capacities. Six staff members enhanced their expertise through targeted trainings in anti corruption, gender equality, Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning and Results Based Management. At the same time, TFL expanded its engagement in national and regional networks, strengthening partnerships and contributing to new funding opportunities. - Efforts to strengthen community resilience and emergency preparedness also delivered significant results. Five Community Resilience Networks were established and strengthened, engaging 84 members (61 women and 23 men). - Outreach activities reached 56.384 individuals online and 757 individuals through inperson sessions, while 21 young people were trained as peer educators on fire prevention and risk awareness.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
